QUOTE: **`fuzzy` is included, not filtered.** The surface does not drop fuzzy edges. The descriptions tell a reader to weigh `confidence`, and `ast_member` edges are mostly fuzzy... so dropping it would remove most of the graph.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the flat surface keeps fuzzy edges, but it never contrasts this with a traversal surface that excludes them. It also never gives the reason that a walk multiplies one fuzzy edge into a wrong subtree.
